method: Exact TARGETSITE character matching to the pinned field inventory. UFI is retained as the package feature key. No inferred alias, nearest polygon, key coercion, site exclusion or replacement. Matching keys do not establish valid geometry or an authoritative complete crosswalk.
limitations: Exact source TARGETSITE-to-field target matching only. No inferred alias, nearest polygon, key truncation, repair, exclusion or replacement.
Package target coordinates describe planned outlet points, not actual field-site positions; they are not imported or substituted.
A matching target key does not establish polygon coverage, valid topology, documented semantics or scientific eligibility. No SHP geometry is decoded.
The package metadata names TargetSite/TARGETSITE and UFI but leaves their detailed attribute definitions blank. Any absent field target needs authoritative explanation before admission.
nextRequired: Resolve the five missing targets from authoritative source documentation; otherwise retain the admission stop. Validate source geometry and site coverage only after the identity requirement is resolved. No assay acquisition, model fit or audit at this stage.

checks.scope: Software/source identity checks only, not independent scientific validation.
